svg.title: TOP266VG 12 V, 30 W open-frame supply
svg.desc: Redrawn from Figure 26 of the TOPSwitch-JX datasheet: an 85 to 264 VAC input, 12 V at 2.5 A output open-frame flyback supply built around a TOP266VG (U1). An EMI filter feeds the diode bridge D1 to D4 and the bulk capacitor C3. The bus feeds the top of the transformer T1 primary, whose bottom is the DRAIN pin. Resistors R1 and R2 in series from the bus feed the VOLTAGE-MONITOR pin V, and a 191 kΩ resistor R12 joins V to the CONTROL pin. Resistors R3 and R4 in series from the bus feed the EXTERNAL CURRENT LIMIT pin X, with R15 from X to the source. A clamp of the Zener VR1 in series with R5, in parallel with C4, and the diode D5 limits the drain spike. A bias winding charges C7 through D7. The phototransistor U2B connects the bias rail to the CONTROL pin. A path of R9, the Zener VR3 and the diode D6 from the bias rail to the V pin shuts the supply down on an output overvoltage. The secondary has the Schottky diodes D8 and D9 with an R17 and C12 snubber, output capacitors C14 and C15, an inductor L2 and C16. The output feedback uses the optocoupler LED U2A and the shunt regulator U3 with its divider R21 and R23.
